$comment: Secrets this gatekeeper takes, read by scripts/release/manifest-lib.ts into the release manifest (ADR 0160). Values are never committed.

secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe secret API key (sk_live_… or a restricted key with Checkout Sessions and Refunds write). Without it the Stripe payment account is refused.

secrets.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Signing secret (whsec_…) of the Stripe webhook endpoint that posts to <BASE_URL>/in/stripe.

secrets.name: FAKE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Signing secret of the fake payment provider's webhook (/in/fake). Generated by the installer and cos deploy when PAYMENTS_FAKE_PROVIDER is on (only in an environment marked live: false) and none is set; kept by later deploys. Without it the fake runs on localhost only.
